brand.name: Aura Finance
brand.description: A mindful, calm, and highly functional cash management tool for multi-platform modern banking.

headings.weight_strategy: Radical contrast: Black (900) for hero numbers, Medium (500) for standard headers.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing. Elements must breathe.
spacing_and_layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Mode for Dashboards. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Every pixel must be utilized with tight correlation. Direct children ONLY in grids.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-lg max-w-[8px] for subtle modern touch. No pill shapes except specific tags.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content and forms.

buttons.primary: bg-[#4A6741] text-white hover:bg-[#3D5636] transition-transform hover:-translate-y-0.5 shadow-sm rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#E7E5E4] text-[#1C1B1A] hover:bg-[#F3F0EA] transition-colors rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium

cards.default: bg-white border border-[#E7E5E4] rounded-lg p-6 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow
cards.interactive: bg-white border border-[#E7E5E4] rounded-lg p-6 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-[#4A6741]/50 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer
cards.ai_prompt_panel: relative bg-[#FDFBF7] border-2 border-[#E6DCCA] rounded-lg p-6 focus-within:border-[#4A6741] focus-within:ring-4 focus-within:ring-[#4A6741]/10 transition-all

inputs.default: w-full bg-white border border-[#E7E5E4] rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-[#1C1B1A] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4A6741]/20 focus:border-[#4A6741] transition-all
inputs.textarea: w-full bg-white border border-[#E7E5E4] rounded-md px-4 py-3 min-h-[120px] resize-y focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#4A6741]/20 focus:border-[#4A6741]

navigation.style: Sticky top nav, bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E7E5E4] z-50

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST have visible hover states altering background, border, or transform. Contrast MUST increase on hover.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease. No 'all'.
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered fade-up for transaction lists (framer-motion, y: 10, opacity: 0).
motion_and_interactions.ai_generation: When AI is generating the report, use 'The Tracing Beam' border effect (animated glowing gradient border) or a subtle pulsating glow around the AI panel.

icons_and_assets.style: Duotone or Regular weight, strictly matching text colors.

hero_background.description: Abstract earthy 3D composition representing financial stability.
hero_background.usage: Auth page split background, or extremely subtle faded background for the landing page hero section.

receipt_lifestyle.description: Minimalist desk flat lay with warm stone texture and receipts.
receipt_lifestyle.usage: Can be used as an illustration in empty states (e.g., 'No transactions yet') or report generator marketing.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Avoid pure transparent overlays.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, forms, and key data points MUST include 'data-testid' using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., 'connect-venmo-button', 'ai-report-prompt-input', 'download-pdf-button').

page_specific_guidelines.auth: Split screen layout. Left: hero_background image covering full height with a dark overlay (bg-stone-900/30). Right: White background, centered form with Google Auth and Email/Password fields.
page_specific_guidelines.dashboard: Control Room Grid. Top row: Aggregate balances and cash flow chart (Shadcn/Recharts). Side column: Provider Connection Status Panel showing connected apps and 'Add New' buttons. Main area: Paginated transaction list.
page_specific_guidelines.report_builder: Two-pane layout. Left: Form controls (Standard Filters: Date, Provider, Category) AND a large textured AI Prompt Textarea (Clay & Crisp style). Right: PDF preview canvas pane (use solid white background with 1px border to represent A4 paper).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the typography, specifically 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headings and 'Work Sans' for body. Do not default to Inter.
Implement the 'Organic & Earthy' color palette. The background should be slightly off-white (#FDFBF7) to reduce eye strain, not pure white.

For the Provider Connection Status Panel, use the generated provider_logos. Map them exactly to Venmo, Cash App, Chime, Stripe, and PayPal respectively. DO NOT use placeholder images if you add more providers; use Phosphor icons instead.
Report generation is a core feature: Ensure the UI clearly distinguishes between standard filters and the AI prompt text area. Provide visual feedback (loaders/skeleton) when generating the PDF.
Use Shadcn UI components but override their default styles to match the 'Clay & Crisp' and 'Solid' aesthetic described. Remove excessive rounded corners; cap them at 8px (rounded-lg).
Add data-testid to every button, link, and input as required by the E1 rules.
